policy.future_characters: Runtime register(actor_id, intelligence, kind) immediately when instantiated.
policy.deceased: Register as archived/inactive; never fabricate new lived experiences after death.
policy.world_truth: No characters automatically know every atlas event.
policy.memory_recording: Only perceived, learned, inferred, rumored, instinctual or explicitly seeded background records become character memories.
policy.archive: Append-only SQLite experiences in save file; recall/accessibility may decay but experiences are not auto-deleted.
